e: Rectocele on defecography is significant once anterior rectal wall bulge exceeds 2 cm.
Asherman syndrome = intrauterine adhesions/endometrial scarring, classically post-curettage.
Cord entanglement is a monoamniotic-twin risk (shared sac); MCDA twins have a dividing membrane so this isn't typical.
Forceps delivery → painful vulvovaginal hematoma, c̅ urinary retention from local pressure on the urethra.
Goodell sign (cervical softening) is classified as a probable sign of pregnancy.
Low-dose aspirin started from 12 weeks is the best evidence-based method to ↓es pre-eclampsia recurrence.
After calling for help, McRoberts manoeuvre c̅ suprapubic pressure is the first step in shoulder dystocia.
CAIS: 46XY c̅ testes present, AMH suppresses Müllerian structures (no uterus), but androgen resistance → female phenotype c̅ scanty pubic/axillary hair despite normal breast development.

LSCS: Green-Armytage (haemostatic), Doyen's retractor, scalpel c̅ BP holder, Allis forceps.
Shirodkar clamp (cerclage), Cusco & Karman (speculum/MVA) not used.
Blurred vision, headache, epigastric pain = imminent eclampsia; pedal oedema is nonspecific.
Previa c̅ mild bleed, stable mother & fetus: hospitalise, expectant management.
PPH unresponsive to massage/uterotonics: balloon tamponade before surgical options.
Trichomonas: frothy yellow-green discharge, strawberry cervix.
AGC on Pap: colposcopy c̅ endocervical + endometrial sampling.
Postmenopausal endometrial thickness >4–5 mm → endometrial biopsy.
Ideal postpartum IUCD insertion: within 10 min of placental delivery.
Uterine inversion → neurogenic (vagal) shock out of proportion to blood loss.
AMH, AFC & basal FSH are the main reserve markers; E2 only helps interpret FSH.
Ascites + omental caking + bilateral adnexal masses + ↑ CA-125 → serous (high-grade) adenocarcinoma.
HPV 16 and 18 cause ~70% of cervical cancers.
Rotterdam criteria: oligo/anovulation (reduced cycles), hyperandrogenism (hirsutism), polycystic ovaries - 2 of 3.
PPH uses oxytocin, methylergometrine, carboprost (15-methyl PGF2α) and misoprostol; dinoprostone is not used.
Maternal fever causes fetal tachycardia, not bradycardia.
Delayed cycles + bilateral tubal spill + bilaterally enlarged ovaries → PCOS.
Culture ≥10⁵ CFU/mL confirmed on repeat = significant bacteriuria; treat in pregnancy as per sensitivity.
Pap smear: lithotomy position, speculum exam, cervical scrape c̅ Ayre's spatula (no prior bimanual exam).
MgSO₄ prevents eclamptic seizures and gives fetal neuroprotection; it is not used to prevent preterm labour.
UTI in pregnancy: commonest complication is preterm labour.
LNG-IUS: insertion within 48 h postpartum or interval insertion within 7 days of menses.
